name: David M. Almaraz
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Sherman Oaks, California
education: University of Southern California Gould School of Law
about: David M. Almaraz is a shareholder at Grant Shenon Almaraz, APLC, in Sherman Oaks, California, bringing over two decades of legal practice to his role. He covers issues of real estate law, landlord-tenant disputes, business litigation, civil litigation, trade secret litigation and more. Known for his commitment to achieving the best for his clients, he is dedicated to understanding his clients’ unique needs and goals. His approach combines insightful legal strategies with thorough problem-solving techniques, ensuring tailored solutions for each case.

Mr. Almaraz is well-regarded for his extensive trial experience in both federal and state courts across California. His ability to guide clients through the complexities of legal proceedings is evident in his adept handling of mediations, arbitrations and various trial formats, including jury and bench trials. When necessary, he is prepared to represent his clients in appeals before the California Courts of Appeal. Throughout all phases of litigation, he emphasizes the importance of pre-litigation counseling and settlement negotiations as valuable steps in the legal process.

Admitted to practice before all state courts of California, the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 9th Circuit, Mr. Almaraz is well-equipped to handle a broad spectrum of legal challenges. His academic foundation includes a Bachelor of Arts in political science from the University of California, Berkeley, followed by a Juris Doctor degree from the University of Southern California.

As an active member of The State Bar of California and the Los Angeles County Bar Association, Mr. Almaraz remains engaged with the legal community, continually enhancing his practice. Rated "Very Good" on Avvo, he is recognized for his dedication and effective advocacy. His sensitivity to clients' needs and loyalty to their objectives make him not only a reliable attorney but also a trusted confidant and formidable opponent in legal battles.
